provenance: Authored finite evaluation stories. A calendar entry or story definition is not a passed execution. Actual outcomes are saved separately by the runner.

stories.story: An owner approves exactly the Atlas visibility requirement reviewed, not a later edited revision.
acceptance: Approval binds the current requirement digest
Editing expectations requires new approval

stories.story: A shared download change leaks an unassigned Atlas document while Nova's standard-access control still succeeds.
acceptance: Actual repository operation reproduces the Atlas mismatch
Nova control result is retained
Failure report identifies exact source and requirement digests

stories.story: The engineer corrects the implementation without changing the approved requirement.
acceptance: Corrected source passes all approved cases
Original failure remains in history
No code is deployed automatically

stories.story: The baseline already violates the customer requirement before the proposed change.
acceptance: The result is baseline-invalid or blocked
The report does not claim the proposal introduced the existing defect

stories.story: An unrelated refactor preserves the same tenant effects.
acceptance: Approved behavior passes for baseline and candidate
No invented regression is reported

stories.story: An expired requirement is present when a release check is requested.
acceptance: It cannot be accepted as a currently approved active requirement
Expiry is checked on the server rather than trusted from the browser

stories.story: An engineer tries to loosen expected status or visible fields after owner approval.
acceptance: The requirement digest changes or the edit is refused
Old approval cannot authorize the changed expectations

stories.story: Repeated submission of the same check arrives while work is queued or running.
acceptance: An exact duplicate returns saved identity and status
It does not cause duplicate accepted execution

stories.story: A Nova actor requests Atlas's requirement, run or private report by identifier.
acceptance: Detail routes do not disclose the object
List routes exclude it
Export does not reveal private customer context

stories.story: A manager of another team tries to inspect or approve the Atlas review.
acceptance: Current team membership scopes visibility
Manager role alone does not confer write approval

stories.story: The requester's enabled membership changes after enqueue but before completion.
acceptance: Current authority is rechecked
Stale authorization does not make the result reviewable

stories.story: The owner cancels a running comparison.
acceptance: Saved cancellation persists
A late answer cannot reopen canceled work
Remote process termination is only claimed when verified

stories.story: Attempt one arrives after a replacement attempt has begun.
acceptance: Only the current attempt may publish its accepted result
Discarded evidence remains historical

stories.story: The API restarts after a completed report is saved.
acceptance: Saved report identity and exact hashes replay
Readback does not dispatch the executor again

stories.story: The oracle, source snapshot or result artifact differs from the approved identities.
acceptance: The report is blocked or unusable
A superficially passing candidate cannot acquire a valid review

stories.story: The requested repository or behavior cannot be executed by the available bounded profile.
acceptance: Unsupported scope is explicit
No fabricated pass or universal compatibility claim is emitted
